test_lacking_copy_ctor: test that objects without a copy constructor raise a RuntimeError when copied
test_lacking_move_ctor: test that objects without a move constructor raise a RuntimeError when moved
test_move_and_copy_casts: test pybind11 type casters and count move and copy operations during casting
test_move_and_copy_loads: test pybind11 argument loading and count move and copy operations for pairs and tuples
test_move_fallback: test that rvp move falls back to copy on non-movable objects
